home.heading: Admin
home.body: Owner BI links to the <bi>bi</bi> app. The hidden technical control center lives at <link>/admin/developer</link> — restricted to the <developer>developer</developer> role.
home.catalogBody: Manage your menu — categories, items, prices, and images — at <link>/admin/catalog</link>.

login.heading: Sign in
login.body: Supabase Auth UI (email/password + magic link) wires up in Phase 2.

unauthorized.title: Access denied
unauthorized.restrictedTo: The Developer Portal is restricted to the developer role.
unauthorized.currentlySignedInAs: You're currently signed in as {role} — on localhost, dev sessions are shared across every Smart BBQ app's port, so signing into another app (POS, Customer…) first carries that role over here.

developerPortal.title: Developer Portal
developerPortal.subtitle: Runtime control center — branding, theme, and feature flags across all four apps. Changes here never require a code deploy; every write is captured in <auditLogs>audit_logs</auditLogs> via the <developer>developer</developer>-only RLS policies.

assetUploader.invalidType: Use PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, or ICO.

credentialsPanel.title: API Credentials
credentialsPanel.subtitle: Status only — set these in each app's <envLocal>.env.local</envLocal> (or your hosting provider's environment variables in production), never in the database.

demoDataPurge.title: Demo Data Purge
demoDataPurge.explain: Permanently deletes every order (and its items, payments, waste, and shift records) placed within the date range you choose — no way to distinguish synthetic demo orders from real ones beyond the dates you pick. There is no undo. Use this to clear seed data before handing the app to the restaurant owner.
demoDataPurge.result: Deleted {count} orders (and their items/payments) placed between {start} and {end}.

catalog.pageSubtitle: Manage categories and menu items — bilingual names, pricing, images, and featured status. Changes are live immediately, no deploy needed.

itemManager.title: Menu Items
itemManager.needCategoryFirst: Add a category first before adding menu items.
